claims.claim: As of August 2026, Anthropic says Claude led 26% of measured AI research work, performed at least collaboratively in more than 90%, and was fully autonomous in none.
claims.limit: Anthropic internal prototype index; self-measured and method-dependent.

claims.claim: Anthropic says “led” means completing most of a defined task from a high-level prompt while a human supervises; fully autonomous work removes the human.
claims.limit: Anthropic uses an Epoch AI scale; boundary judgments can differ.

claims.claim: OpenAI says that by mid-August its research organization used 3.1 agent-workdays for every human workday.
claims.limit: Internal provider metric using a standard eight-hour workday.

claims.claim: OpenAI says people still set research priorities, judge results, and decide whether to scale, pause or deploy.
claims.limit: Provider description of current internal practice.

claims.claim: OpenAI says over half of successful four-to-eight-hour tasks in the studied six months involved at least one intervention.
claims.limit: Successful tasks with ground-truth outcomes; provider classifier and internal sample.
